evidenceType: Blender source render, not actual app
findings: The eastern entrance and ascent are visible, but the steep smooth outer band reads as a slide rather than the benchmark wooden staircase and inhabited gallery.
The absent supporting boughs and rails leave an unsupported appearance. The build stopped before those stages.
The inner passage remains dark and visually constrained. Actor passage has not been verified.
The entry-left black cut and whole-view dark dots cannot be attributed to v4 geometry alone; source, camera and shadow effects remain confounded.
decision: After v2 and v4 visual comparisons, change the construction method to actual stairs with shared tread/riser vertices. The same visible tread surfaces must support actual feet and the use route; no hidden ramp with cosmetic steps.
nextConstraints: Keep the four owner IDs, original trunk/fan, house/door, main endpoints and 0.64 width.

Determine step count and spacing from actual left/right foot geometry, heading and walking phases. The old 0.114833 figure was a smoothstep centerline run, not an inner-edge measurement; it does not establish that 18 steps are impossible.
Use explicit use-floor IDs and 3D routes when integrated. Preserve default ground/site support and existing owner rights.
